## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and before/after behavior. Link a non-sensitive
issue when relevant. Vulnerabilities follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Validation

List the focused regression, broader gates, direct exit results, and any optional
skips or missing prerequisites. For installer/payload changes include isolated
packed install, repeat/migration, doctor, and removal evidence. Distinguish local
fixtures from authenticated host or public-registry proof.

## Risks and cleanup

Note compatibility, ownership, privacy, permission, or network effects. Confirm
temporary profiles and child processes were cleaned up. Redact excerpts; do not
attach raw transcripts, credentials, private settings, or local-state directories.

- [ ] The diff is limited to the intended scope and follows [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Shipped resources and linked documentation agree with the tested behavior.
- [ ] No private data, generated evidence, or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Version and release actions, if proposed, have separate explicit approval.
